relax.page_subtitle: Let your body and mind rest. Simple breathing and meditation practices to help you find calm.
relax.exercise_breath_desc: 4-7-8 breathing method to help your body relax and relieve tension
relax.exercise_body_scan_desc: Scan from head to toe, release tension and fatigue
relax.exercise_mindfulness_desc: Focus on the present moment, let your thoughts slowly quiet down
relax.exercise_five_senses_desc: Return to the present through your five senses, reduce anxiety
relax.exercise_cat_game_desc: Play a matching game with cute cats, relax and relieve stress
relax.breath_subtitle: Follow the circle's rhythm to quickly calm physical tension
relax.breath_instruction: Click the start button and follow the guided breathing exercise
relax.breath_instruction_default: Click the start button and follow the guided breathing exercise
relax.guide_inhale: Breathe in slowly, feel the air entering your body...
relax.guide_hold: Hold, let your body absorb the oxygen...
relax.breath_complete_tip: You have completed 4 breathing cycles. How do you feel?
relax.science_breath: Slow, deep breathing activates the parasympathetic nervous system, lowers cortisol levels, and reduces amygdala overactivity.
relax.practice_tips_text: Place one hand on your chest and the other on your abdomen. Breathe in slowly, feel your abdomen rise like a balloon; hold for 2-3 seconds; breathe out slowly, feel your abdomen contract.
relax.body_scan_subtitle: Feel each part of your body
relax.body_scan_instruction: Click start, we will scan each part of your body from head to toe
relax.scan_instr_head: Focus your attention on the top of your head. Feel the temperature and sensation here. Is there any tension? Let it slowly relax.
relax.scan_instr_forehead: Feel your forehead. Are you frowning? Let it smooth out and relax.
relax.scan_instr_eyes: Feel around your eyes. Let the eye sockets relax, let your eyes rest naturally.
relax.scan_instr_face: Notice your cheeks and jaw. Are you clenching your teeth? Let your mouth open slightly, relax.
relax.scan_instr_shoulders: Feel your shoulders. We often accumulate tension here. Let your shoulders drop, relax.
relax.scan_instr_arms: From upper arms to forearms, all the way to your fingers. Feel their presence, let them fully relax.
relax.scan_instr_chest: Feel your chest. With each breath, feel it rise and fall gently.
relax.scan_instr_abdomen: Focus your attention on your abdomen. Let your breath naturally come here, feel your abdomen rise and fall.
relax.scan_instr_legs: From thighs to calves, all the way to your toes. Feel the presence of your legs, let them fully relax.
relax.scan_instr_whole: Now feel your entire body. From head to toe, completely relaxed. Enjoy this tranquility.
relax.scan_complete_tip: Your body has been scanned from head to toe. Take a moment to feel your current state.
relax.mindfulness_instruction: Close your eyes, focus your attention on your breath. No need to change your breathing, just observe it.
relax.mf_instr_1: Close your eyes, focus your attention on your breath.
relax.mf_instr_2: Feel the air enter your nasal passage, fill your chest.
relax.mf_instr_3: No need to change your breathing, just observe it.
relax.mf_instr_4: If your mind wanders away, it's okay, gently bring it back to your breath.
relax.mf_instr_5: With each breath, let yourself relax even more.
relax.mf_instr_6: In this moment, there is only you and your breath.
relax.mf_instr_7: Let your body fully relax, let your thoughts slowly quiet down.
relax.mf_instr_8: You are doing well, continue focusing on your breath.
relax.mf_complete_tip: Slowly open your eyes. Feel yourself in this moment.
relax.science_neuro_desc: Mindfulness practice reduces amygdala overactivity. 8 weeks of systematic practice can establish stable emotional regulation neural pathways. If your mind wanders, gently bring your attention back to your breath.
relax.five_senses_subtitle: Return to the present through your five senses
relax.five_senses_desc: This practice helps you return from anxious thoughts to the present. Take your time, no need to rush.
relax.see_5_desc: Look around, find 5 things you can see
relax.hear_3_desc: Listen for 3 sounds you can hear
relax.retry_desc: Load failed, please try again later

flow.hero_subtitle: Flow is a state of complete focus and immersion. Here you'll find activities that help you enter flow, and record your flow experiences.
flow.flow_preview: Flow is a state of complete focus where you forget time and are fully immersed in an activity. This state is called "flow" - the highest form of intrinsic motivation.
flow.feature_1: Complete focus, losing track of time
flow.flow_science: Neuroimaging studies show that during flow, activity in the prefrontal cortex decreases - this is called "transient hypofrontalityit" - reducing self-criticism and increasing creativity.
flow.flow_tip: You don't need to force yourself into flow. Choose an activity you enjoy, eliminate distractions, and flow will naturally arrive.
flow.how_to_flow_preview: Entering flow isn't accidental - it requires the right conditions. Here are the key preconditions and practical tips to help you enter flow more easily.
flow.cond_2_desc: - Know at any moment whether you're on the right track
flow.cond_3_desc: - Difficulty slightly exceeds current skill level
flow.tip_5: Allow an adaptation period - don't expect immediate flow
flow.choose_duration_goal: Flow requires a clear goal and sufficient time. Set your expected duration and specific goal to help you enter flow faster.
flow.goal_placeholder: e.g., Complete line art coloring, Read 2 chapters...
flow.goal_tip: 💡 Tip: Goals should be specific and achievable, not vague like "work hard"
flow.assess_desc: Flow requires matching challenge to your skill level. Assess your skill level and the activity's challenge level to find your optimal flow zone.
flow.balance_tip: 💡 Tip: When challenge and skill are balanced, you're most likely to enter flow. If it's too easy, try increasing the challenge; if too hard, learn the basics first.
flow.prepare_env: A good environment helps you enter flow faster. Prepare the following to minimize distractions.
flow.check_notif: Turn off phone notifications or enable Do Not Disturb
flow.check_env: Find a quiet and comfortable environment
flow.breathing_exercise: Do a 1-minute breathing exercise to enter a focused state
flow.breath_guide: Inhale 4 sec → Hold 4 sec → Exhale 4 sec
flow.summary_text:

role.role.conflict_empty_text: Each role is a part of you, together they make up the complete you
role.role.sug_item_boundaries_0: Turn off work notifications after get off work
role.role.sug_item_boundaries_1: At least half a day on weekends fully for yourself
role.role.sug_item_boundaries_2: Learn to say "no", refuse unnecessary requests
role.role.sug_item_timemgmt_0: Use Pomodoro technique to improve efficiency
role.role.sug_item_timemgmt_1: Set aside 1 hour daily for things you enjoy
role.role.sug_item_timemgmt_2: Assign dedicated time to different roles
role.role.sug_item_selfcare_0: Reward yourself at least once a week
role.role.sug_item_selfcare_1: Exercise regularly, maintain physical and mental health
role.role.sug_item_selfcare_2: Give yourself space to make mistakes and rest
role.role.sug_item_support_0: Share your feelings with family and friends
role.role.sug_item_support_2: Join a support group, connect with people with similar experiences
role.role.harmony_family_0: ${emoji1} ${name1} and ${emoji2} ${name2} — you play multiple important roles in the family, which requires a lot of love, but also harvests so much love
role.role.harmony_family_1: Although multiple roles in the family are busy, it also makes you needed and cherished by more people
role.role.harmony_social_0: ${emoji1} ${name1} and ${emoji2} ${name2} — you bear multiple responsibilities in society, this is not easy, but you did it
role.role.harmony_social_1: These two social roles give you richer experience and broader vision
role.role.harmony_self_0: ${emoji1} ${name1} and ${emoji2} ${name2} are both identities you chose for yourself, this self-drive is beautiful
role.role.harmony_self_1: Walking multiple paths on the journey of self-growth, just maintain this curiosity
role.role.harmony_generic: ${name1} and ${name2}, both are part of you
role.role.harmony_cross: ${emoji1} ${name1} (from ${cat1}) and ${emoji2} ${name2} (from ${cat2}) together constitute your rich life — you are truly amazing for being able to play them well
role.role.parent-partner_desc: Parenting responsibilities often quietly take over your conversation space with your partner, which is common in many families
role.role.parent-partner_sug: Children need to see you love each other. Set aside "just the two of you" time every week, even if it's just a 20-minute walk together.
role.role.parent-child_desc: Parenting and caring for parents happen simultaneously — this is the typical stress of the "sandwich generation"
role.role.parent-child_sug: You don't need to be perfect. Share responsibilities with siblings, and allow yourself to feel overwhelmed sometimes. Seeking external support is not failure, it's wisdom.
role.role.partner-child_desc: Between your partner relationship and caring for parents, sometimes a delicate balance is needed
role.role.partner-child_sug: Let your partner join in with your family relationships. Visiting parents together makes the relationship more natural.
role.role.sibling-parent_desc: Siblings may have different views on parenting
role.role.sibling-parent_sug: Seek common ground while respecting differences. Stay aligned on core issues, allow differences in details.
role.role.employee-parent_desc: Work and parenting are both competing for your attention and energy — this is the most common experience for modern parents
role.role.employee-parent_sug: Quality over quantity. 15 minutes of fully focused companionship each day is more meaningful than a whole day of "accompanying children while looking at your phone".
role.role.employee-partner_desc: Work fatigue often leaves you with no energy to nurture your intimate relationship after geting off work
role.role.employee-partner_sug: Put "date night" on your calendar. Put down your phone before bed and chat for 10 minutes.
role.role.employee-child_desc: When work is busy, it's hard to find time to accompany and care for parents
role.role.employee-child_sug: Quality matters more than frequency. Have regular video calls, and plan visits home in advance for holidays. Help parents find a community support network.
role.role.employee-sibling_desc: Busy with work respectively, the sense of connection between siblings may gradually weaken
role.role.employee-sibling_sug: You don't need frequent contact, but show up for each other at important moments. Occasionally share small moments from life, let each other know "I'm here".
role.role.freelancer-parent_desc: Working from home lets you accompany your children, but also easily blurs the boundary between work and family
role.role.freelancer-parent_sug: Create a sense of ritual for "work time" with your children. Also teach your children: freelancing is real work too.
role.role.entrepreneur-parent_desc: The uncertainty and high-intensity investment of starting a business may affect your sense of stability as a parent
role.role.entrepreneur-parent_sug: Let your children understand your work, but don't pass the pressure of entrepreneurship to them. Set "no-work" family time.
role.role.student-parent_desc: With dual identities of student and parent, your time is especially tight
role.role.student-parent_sug: You are showing your child the best example of "lifelong learning". Seek parenting support from school or community.
role.role.student-employee_desc: The half-work-half-study life leaves you with barely any time to breathe
role.role.student-employee_sug: Your efforts will blossom and bear fruit. Plan your time reasonably, and give yourself moments to rest.
role.role.parent-learner_desc: Parenting takes up a lot of time, and self-improvement plans are often put on hold
role.role.parent-learner_sug: Let your children see that mom and dad are also learning. Use fragment time for learning — you can make progress without large blocks of time.
role.role.parent-creator_desc: Creation requires focus and time, yet parenting requires being on call at any moment
role.role.parent-creator_sug: Schedule creative time during your children's stable activity periods. You can also let your children participate in your creation.
role.role.parent-volunteer_desc: You want to help others, but must first take good care of yourself and your family
role.role.parent-volunteer_sug: Participate in volunteer service together with your children — it can help others and also cultivate your children's empathy.
role.role.parent-explorer_desc: After having children, the way you explore the world has changed
role.role.parent-explorer_sug: Explore together with your children — go to new parks, try new foods. Children are the best exploration partners.
role.role.partner-learner_desc: In the process of self-growth, sometimes your partner may feel left out
role.role.partner-learner_sug: Share what you've learned with your partner. You can also invite your partner to learn a topic together.
role.role.partner-creator_desc: Creation requires alone time, which may make your partner feel ignored
role.role.partner-creator_sug: Share your creations with your partner. Let them be the first reader of your work.
role.role.child-learner_desc: Both caring for parents and learning growth require investment, and time and energy need careful allocation
role.role.child-learner_sug: Improving yourself is also to better care for your parents. Let your parents see your progress — they will be proud of you.
role.role.child-creator_desc: Creation takes time, and caring for parents also takes time
role.role.child-creator_sug: Combine creation with caring for parents — draw a picture for your parents, write a poem. They will treasure it.
role.role.sibling-learner_desc: Each is walking on a different growth path
role.role.sibling-learner_sug: Occasionally share what you've learned with your siblings. Blood connection + growing together is the deepest bond.
role.role.employee-learner_desc: Work is already tiring, and you still need to spare energy for learning — this requires strong internal drive
role.role.employee-learner_sug: Combine learning content with work. The 30 minutes after waking up or before sleep is the easiest time to stick to learning.
role.role.employee-creator_desc: Work consumes most of your creativity, making it hard to start creating after geting off work
role.role.employee-creator_sug: Creation doesn't have to be a "big project". 15 minutes of casual daily notes can keep your creativity from drying up.
role.role.employee-explorer_desc: The certainty of work often makes people forget to explore more possibilities of themselves
role.role.employee-explorer_sug: Exploration doesn't have to be "quitting your job to see the world" — it can be trying a new restaurant every week, or reading a book from a different field.
role.role.employee-volunteer_desc: Work is already busy, and volunteer service may make you feel even more pressed for time
role.role.employee-volunteer_sug: Helping others doesn't require large blocks of time. An extra bit of kindness and patience in daily life counts as "volunteering".
role.role.freelancer-creator_desc: Freelancing and creating may compete for your time and energy
role.role.freelancer-creator_sug: If possible, make creation part of your freelancing. Set aside sacred, non-negotiable time for "pure creation".
role.role.entrepreneur-learner_desc: Starting a business requires fast learning, but systematic learning is often squeezed out by urgent matters
role.role.entrepreneur-learner_sug: Embed learning into the entrepreneurship process. Treat every problem encountered as a learning topic.
role.role.entrepreneur-creator_desc: Starting a business requires rationality and logic, while creation requires emotion and inspiration — both need balance
role.role.entrepreneur-creator_sug: Entrepreneurship is another form of creation. Treat your startup project as your greatest creation.
role.role.entrepreneur-explorer_desc: Entrepreneurship requires focus and persistence, while exploration requires openness and experimentation
role.role.entrepreneur-explorer_sug: Entrepreneurship itself is a form of exploration. Integrate the exploratory spirit into the entrepreneurship process — try new business models.
role.role.student-creator_desc: Academic pressure may limit the time and energy you can invest in creation
role.role.student-creator_sug: Student days are the most suitable time for creation. Even just 15 minutes of creation daily nourishes your creativity.
role.role.student-explorer_desc: Student days are the most suitable time for exploration, but academic pressure may limit your exploration
role.role.student-explorer_sug: Integrate exploration into learning — take a course you know nothing about, meet a classmate from a different background.
role.role.student-volunteer_desc: Both academics and volunteer service are taking up your time
role.role.student-volunteer_sug: Volunteer service is your best "extracurricular education". What it teaches you may be more than textbooks.
role.role.learner-volunteer_desc: Learning and volunteer service are both taking up your free time — need to find balance
role.role.learner-volunteer_sug: Volunteer service itself is also a form of learning. Record your volunteer service experiences — it will become a precious treasure in your life.
role.role.learner-explorer_desc: Learning and exploration are a very natural combination — they inspire each other
role.role.learner-explorer_sug: Maintain this curiosity and desire to learn. Learning and exploration don't have to have a "purpose" — sometimes the most beautiful discoveries happen casually.
role.role.creator-volunteer_desc: Creation requires focused solitude, while volunteer service requires outward connection — allocating energy needs wisdom
role.role.creator-volunteer_sug: Your creativity can be used to serve others. Teach others the creative skills you excel at — this is a very meaningful volunteer service.
role.role.creator-explorer_desc: Exploration gives you inspiration, creation helps you express — this is a great partnership
role.role.creator-explorer_sug: Let exploration become the source of your creation. Go to new places, meet people from different backgrounds — they all become nourishment for creation.
role.role.explorer-volunteer_desc: Exploring the world and serving others are both ways of opening yourself to the outside
role.role.explorer-volunteer_sug: Volunteer service can be a form of exploration — go to different places, meet people from different backgrounds. Let the two nourish each other.
